summary.motive: Gasoline the defense with heavy gap-scheme power: down blocks create an unmovable wall, while a pulling guard kicks out the edge and a lead tight end pancakes the linebacker.
summary.whyItWorks: Down blocks give offensive linemen superior angles of leverage. The pulling guard creates a massive gap by kicking the edge defender out, while the lead-blocking tight end ensures the running back enters the secondary untouched.
summary.failureMode: A penetrating defensive tackle shooting through the vacated backside guard gap or an edge defender spilling inside to blow up the pullers.

beats.title: 13-Personnel Heavy Alignment
beats.text: Stefanski shows his hallmark heavy 3-TE set, daring the defense to load the box before executing counter gap mechanics.

beats.title: Down Blocks & Backside Pullers
beats.text: RT and Y execute down blocks to seal the interior, while backside LG and Wing F pull across the formation into the attack point.

beats.title: The Kickout & Lead Collision
beats.text: LG violently kicks out the edge defender SDE, while F wraps tight through the B/C gap crease to pancake the Mike linebacker.

beats.title: RB Gash Through the Crease
beats.text: Running back follows the pulling convoy, cuts off the inside shoulder of the LG kickout, and erupts into the secondary for a 16-yard gain.

relations.tell: Backside LG and F pull across formation on GT/GF counter paths; RB takes counter jab step before cutting back.
